Device Rings on Successive calls, if a call was missed in Silent or Vibrate Mode.\n\nNotifications can be dismissed to disable the ringing.
Device makes a short sound after a missed call in all ringer Modes.
Quickly change ringer modes by double pressing volume buttons when the screen is on

To use this feature, the app needs access to the volume buttons of the device. This is managed by the Accessibility permission.
Press continue to provide these in the settings menu.
 
This permission is only needed to access the volume buttons and no other information is used or created.

Your privacy is most important and you can disable this feature or permission anytime.
